criteria.evidence: STATUSES and cmdStatus support approved and list it first. The passing AC1 tests exercise status handling and verify that the build skill's Approved section requires both logs, setting approved and committing the ticket and review records, without PR commands. This verifies the agent instructions rather than an end-to-end agent run.

shipChecks checks approval, nextAction, reviewed ancestry and paths from every subsequent commit using git log -m. runTests now refuses an empty command. The passing AC2 refusal test covers unapproved status, dirty files, later code changes, reverted changes, absent approval, missing test configuration and failing tests.

shipTicket sets done, creates a --no-ff merge, deletes the ticket branch and leaves the base checked out. Passing AC3 integration tests check successful delivery, conflict rollback and invocation from main.

shipTicket pushes the configured base-branch remote and reports push failures with recovery instructions. Passing AC4 tests cover successful pushing, refused pushing, no remote and doctor reporting gh as optional.

The ship skill runs speck ship and has disable-model-invocation: true. The passing AC5 test checks user-only shipping instructions in the build and review skills, docs/brief.md and the AGENTS.md pointer generated by init.

findings.issue: The previous endpoint comparison missed post-review code changes that were later reverted.
findings.suggested_fix: Implemented: inspect paths across subsequent commits, including merge commits; regression coverage checks a change followed by its revert.

findings.issue: Shipping previously proceeded without a configured test command.
findings.suggested_fix: Implemented: refuse an empty commands.test with configuration guidance; regression coverage checks refusal and unchanged state.

findings.issue: The build skill test previously omitted the required logs and approval commit.
findings.suggested_fix: Implemented: verify the Approved section requires both logs before setting approved and explicitly requires committing the ticket and review records. This is appropriate coverage of the skill instructions.

product_md.note: The updated specification matches the mandatory test configuration and commit-by-commit approval safeguard.

verdict.summary: The three earlier findings are resolved. Approved tickets now wait for the user, and shipping checks approval and tests before merging locally and optionally pushing. The supplied suite reports all 31 tests passing. Approval is based on the supplied diffs and test output; sandbox startup prevented independent command execution.
